scope: Archive the one completed current-policy relative-decoder RL iteration only after both frozen native strength screens and independent audits finish. Include complete source-rule replay audits, actual optimizer budget, validation selection, exact played model digest and all positive/negative/technical flags. result.warning: A single development match is not a promotion or an all-engine superiority claim.

independent_audit.scope: Post-match replay using pinned native referee; t fields are measured wall times rounded to milliseconds. Each clock check allows +/-0.5ms measurement rounding; ambiguous margins are reported, never silently certified. This verifies records, not statistical superiority or all-engine coverage.
